description: This file defines the 'Host' class in the 'device' namespace, including various methods for managing power modes, video and audio ports, device capabilities, and configuration settings. It serves as a header for the implementation of device host functionalities.

classes.name: Host
classes.description: A class providing an interface to control and query device host settings such as power modes, audio/video ports, and device capabilities.

methods.name: bool setPowerMode(int mode)
methods.description: Sets the power mode of the device.

methods.name: int getPowerMode()
methods.description: Retrieves the current power mode of the device.

methods.name: getPreferredSleepMode
methods.description: Returns the preferred sleep mode.

methods.name: setPreferredSleepMode
methods.description: Sets the preferred sleep mode.

methods.name: getAvailableSleepModes
methods.description: Returns a list of available sleep modes.

methods.name: addPowerModeListener
methods.description: Adds a listener for power mode changes.

methods.name: removePowerModeChangeListener
methods.description: Removes a power mode change listener.

methods.name: addDisplayConnectionListener
methods.description: Adds a listener for display connection changes.

methods.name: removeDisplayConnectionListener
methods.description: Removes a display connection change listener.

methods.name: Host & getInstance(void)
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the Host class.

methods.name: getVideoOutputPorts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available video output ports.

methods.name: List<AudioOutputPort> getAudioOutputPorts()
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available audio output ports.

methods.name: List<VideoDevice> getVideoDevices()
methods.description: Returns a list of connected video devices.

methods.name: VideoOutputPort & getVideoOutputPort(const std::string & name)
methods.description: Returns a reference to a specific video output port by name.

methods.name: getVideoOutputPort
methods.description: Returns a reference to a specific video output port by ID.

methods.name: AudioOutputPort & getAudioOutputPort(const std::string & name)
methods.description: Returns a reference to a specific audio output port by name.

methods.name: AudioOutputPort & getAudioOutputPort(int id)
methods.description: Returns a reference to a specific audio output port by ID.

methods.name: notifyPowerChange
methods.description: Notifies the system of a change in power mode.

methods.name: float getCPUTemperature()
methods.description: Returns the current CPU temperature.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the host's version number.

methods.name: setVersion
methods.description: Sets the host's version number.

methods.name: getHostEDID
methods.description: Retrieves the EDID data from the host.

methods.name: getSocIDFromSDK
methods.description: Returns the System on Chip ID from the SDK.

methods.name: getSinkDeviceAtmosCapability
methods.description: Retrieves the Atmos capability of the sink device.

methods.name: setAudioAtmosOutputMode
methods.description: Enables or disables Atmos audio output mode.

methods.name: setAssociatedAudioMixing
methods.description: Sets whether audio mixing is enabled.

methods.name: getAssociatedAudioMixing
methods.description: Retrieves whether audio mixing is enabled.

methods.name: setFaderControl
methods.description: Adjusts the fader control for audio mixing.

methods.name: getFaderControl
methods.description: Retrieves the current fader control setting.

methods.name: setPrimaryLanguage
methods.description: Sets the primary language.

methods.name: getPrimaryLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the primary language.

methods.name: setSecondaryLanguage
methods.description: Sets the secondary language.

methods.name: getSecondaryLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the secondary language.

methods.name: isHDMIOutPortPresent
methods.description: Checks if HDMI output port is present.

methods.name: std::string getDefaultVideoPortName()
methods.description: Returns the default video port name.

methods.name: getDefaultAudioPortName
methods.description: Returns the default audio port name.

methods.name: getCurrentAudioFormat
methods.description: Retrieves the current audio format.

methods.name: getMS12ConfigDetails
methods.description: Retrieves the MS12 configuration details.
